objects.mission_description: The Enemy seeks dominion over the free peoples of mankind.  Become a Constellation Knight of the Revolution to defend the West.  Intensely train the body, spirit and mind.  Learn to discern sins among yourself and the people you know.  Stay abreast of the movements of the enemy.  As you grow, he moves with deadly precision against us all.  You must be smart, holy and strong to defend the realm and unify all religions to create a new United States that walks with God.

enemy_moves.movement_description: The Enemy has animated the Duchy of Moscovy and its Russian Empire to attack the free people of Ukraine.
The Enemy has duped many white people into the worship of the false gods of power, and many are financed by Russia.
Russia is allied with the Neo Confederacy movement in the USA, influencing white nationalist groups and supporting Confederate uprisings.
Russia is allied with Iran and North Korea
The President and his chief confederates are Russian assets
The Enemy's servants seek white supremacy with Russia
The Enemy preys on weak minds.
The Enemy attacks above all the will of men to choose their own government.
The Enemy mercilessly exploits women as objects for their amusement.
The Enemy uses security as an excuse to subjugate.
The Enemy deploys his police to ensure compliance.
The Enemy seeks to weaken our nation with the corruption of men.
The Enemy seeks to lower our population and divide us, using their assets to drive people out.
The Enemy tries to dominate with threats.
